## Overview

The wave-pooled level counterpart of the per-wave `concurrent` models and of the transition-based `mechanism` family. It answers the question neither does: pooled across all four waves, how does letter-sound level go with word-reading level?

The exposure is split into its child mean and the deviation from it, so the between-child and within-child associations are reported separately rather than blended.

## Model

$$
\\eta = \\alpha_{\\text{wave}} + \\beta_G G
  + \\beta_{\\text{between}}\\bar z_i + \\beta_{\\text{within}}(z_{it} - \\bar z_i)
  + \\gamma_A z(A) + \\sum_c \\gamma_c z(c) + u_{\\text{child}}
$$

where $z_{it}$ is the standardised exposure logit at wave $t$ and $\\bar z_i$ its
child mean. There is deliberately no own-baseline term.
